Name: Data Extension Segment Subheader
Description: The NITF Data Extension Segment (DES) segment subheader defined in MIL-STD-2500C Section 5.1.6 and Table A-8. Datasets contain two types of DESs: TRE overflow DESs, and independent DESs.

DESTAG.Name: File Part Type
DESTAG.Description: This field shall contain the characters 'DE' to identify the subheader as a data extension.

DESID.Name: Unique DES Type Identifier
DESID.Description: The alphanumeric identifier properly registered with the ISMC.

DESVER.Name: Version of the Data Definition
DESVER.Description: The alphanumeric version number of the use of the tag. The version number is assigned as part of the registration process.

DESCLAS.Name: DES Security Classification
DESCLAS.Description: The classification level of the DES, including all sub segments.

DESCLSY.Name: DES Security Classification System
DESCLSY.Description: The national or multinational security system used to classify the DES. Country Codes per FIPS PUB 10-4 shall be used to indicate national security systems. The designator 'XN' is for classified data generated by a component using NATO security system marking guidance. This code is outside the FIPS 10-4 document listing, and was selected to not duplicate that document's existing codes. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no security classification system applies to the DES.

DESCODE.Name: DES Codewords
DESCODE.Description: The security compartments associated with the DES. Values include one or more of the digraphs. Multiple entries shall be separated by a single space: The selection of a relevant set of codewords is application specific. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no codewords apply to the DES.

DESCTLH.Name: DES Control and Handling
DESCTLH.Description: The additional security control and/or handling instructions (caveats) associated with the DES. Values include digraphs. The digraph may indicate single or multiple caveats. The selection of a relevant caveat(s) is application specific. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no additional control and handling instructions apply to the DES.

DESREL.Name: DES Releasing Instructions
DESREL.Description: A list of country and/or multilateral entity codes to which countries and/or multilateral entities the DES is authorized for release. Valid items in the list are one or more country codes as found in FIPS PUB 10-4 separated by a single space. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no DES release instructions apply.

DESDCTP.Name: DES Declassification Type
DESDCTP.Description: The indicator of the type of security declassification or downgrading instructions which apply to the DES.

Values.DE: Declassify upon occurrence of an event
Values.GD: Downgrade to a specified level on a specific date
Values.GE: Downgrade to a specified level upon occurrence of an event
Values: No DES security declassification or downgrading instructions

DESDCDT.Name: DES Declassification Date
DESDCDT.Description: The date on which a DES is to be declassified if the value of DESDCTP is 'DD'. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no DES declassification date applies.

DESDCXM.Name: DES Declassification Exemption
DESDCXM.Description: The reason the DES is exempt from automatic declassification if the value of DESDCTP is 'X'. Valid values are X1 to X8 and X251 to X259. X1 to X8 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-202b(1) to (8) for material exempt from the 10-year rule. X251 to X259 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-301a(1) to (9) for permanently valuable material exempt from the 25-year declassification system. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that a DES declassification exemption does not apply.

DESDG.Name: DES Downgradee
DESDG.Description: The classification level to which a DES is to be downgraded if the values of DESDCTP are 'GD' or 'GE'.

Values: DES security downgrading does not apply

DESDGDT.Name: DES Downgrade Date
DESDGDT.Description: The date on which a DES is to be downgraded if the value of DESDCTP is 'GD'. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that a DES security downgrading date does not apply.

DESCLTX.Name: DES Classification Text
DESCLTX.Description: The additional information about DES classification to include identification of a declassification or downgrading event if the values in DESDCTP are 'DE' or 'GE'. It may also be used to identify multiple classification sources and/or any other special handling rules. Values are user defined free DES. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that additional information about DES classification does not apply.

DESCATP.Name: DES Classification Authority Type
DESCATP.Description: The type of authority used to classify the DES.

Values: DES classification authority type does not apply

DESCAUT.Name: DES Classification Authority
DESCAUT.Description: The classification authority for the DES dependent upon the value in DESCATP. Values are user defined free DES which should contain the following information: original classification authority name and position or personal identifier if the value in DES Classification Authority Type is O; title of the document or security classification guide used to classify the DES if the value in DES Classification Authority Type is D; and Derive-Multiple if the DES classification was derived from multiple sources and the value of the DESCATP field is M. In the latter case, the DES originator will maintain a record of the sources used in accordance with existing security directives. One of the multiple sources may also be identified in DES Classification DES if desired. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no DES classification authority applies.

DESCRSN.Name: DES Classification Reason
DESCRSN.Description: The reason for classifying the DES. Valid values are A to G. These correspond to the reasons for original classification per E.O. 12958, Section 1.5.(a) to (g). If this field contains a space, it shall imply that no DES classification reason applies.

DESRDT.Name: DES Security Source Date
DESRDT.Description: The date of the source used to derive the classification of the DES. In the case of multiple sources, the date of the most recent source shall be used. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that a DES security source date does not apply.

DESCTLN.Name: DES Security Control Number
DESCTLN.Description: A valid security control number associated with the DES. The format of the security control number shall be in accordance with the regulations governing the appropriate security channel(s). If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no DES security control number applies.

DESOFLW.Name: DES Overflowed Header Type
DESOFLW.Description: This field indicates the segment type to which the enclosed TRE is relevant.

Values.UDID: User Defined Image Segment Overflow Data

DESITEM.Name: DES Data Item Overflowed
DESITEM.Description: The number of the data item in the file, of the type indicated in DESOFLW to which the TRE in the segment apply. For example, if DESOFLW = UDID and DESITEM = 003, then the TRE in the segment applies to the third image in the file. If the value of DESOFLW = UDHD, the value of DESITEM shall be zeros.

DESSHL.Name: DES User-defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: The number of bytes in the user defined subheader.

DESSHF.Name: DES User-defined Subheader Fields
DESSHF.Description: The user-defined fields. Data in this field shall be alphanumeric, formatted according to user specification.

DESDATA.Name: DES User-defined Data
DESDATA.Description: The data of either binary or character types defined by and formatted according to the users specification.
